# Typicality by counting / 计数中的典型

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`typicality-by-counting` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](typicality-by-counting.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Counting shows that most courses show the weights: with natural weights p and q on two values, the weighted squared deviations of the courses of n steps add up exactly to n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ, so the courses far off weigh a share that falls with n. Which course happens lies outside what counting decides.
>
> 计数给出多数历程显示权重：两个值以自然数权重 p、q 计数，n 步历程加权的平方偏差恰好加起来是 n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ，偏差大的历程所占之重随 n 下降。发生的是哪一个历程，在计数所定之外。

## Laws / 规律

1. The courses of n steps are exactly the lists of n values, 2ⁿ of them; weighing p for each one and q for each zero, they weigh (p + q)ⁿ together.<br>n 步的历程恰是 n 个值的列表，共 2ⁿ 个；每个一计 p、每个零计 q，合起来重 (p + q)ⁿ。 (`Becoming.Typicality.ones`, `Becoming.Typicality.zeros`, `Becoming.Typicality.weight`, `Becoming.Typicality.courses`, `Becoming.Typicality.total`, `Becoming.Typicality.mem_courses_iff`, `Becoming.Typicality.courses_length`, `Becoming.Typicality.total_weight`)
2. The spread is exact: reading a course with a ones and b zeros by x = q·a and y = p·b, the weighted x·x + y·y summed over the courses of n steps is the weighted 2·x·y summed plus n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ; each step adds p·q·(p + q) times the weight, whatever came before.<br>平方偏差之和恰好：a 个一、b 个零的历程以 x = q·a、y = p·b 读，n 步历程加权的 x·x + y·y 之和，是加权的 2·x·y 之和加 n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ；每一步加 p·q·(p + q) 乘其权重，无论之前如何。 (`Becoming.Typicality.ahead`, `Becoming.Typicality.behind`, `Becoming.Typicality.square`, `Becoming.Typicality.cross`, `Becoming.Typicality.steps_leave`, `Becoming.Typicality.spread`)
3. Most courses show the weights: those with x·x + y·y ≥ 2·x·y + d weigh, times d, at most n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ; so those whose frequency of ones is off p / (p + q) by ε or more weigh a share of at most p·q / ((p + q)²·ε²·n).<br>多数历程显示权重：x·x + y·y ≥ 2·x·y + d 的历程之重乘 d 至多 n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ；所以一的频率与 p / (p + q) 相差 ε 以上者，所占之重至多 p·q / ((p + q)²·ε²·n)。 (`Becoming.Typicality.two_mul_le`, `Becoming.Typicality.offBy`, `Becoming.Typicality.offBy_le`, `Becoming.Typicality.typical`)
4. The weights are those of the sum over histories: free branching weighted by counting composes along each history the weight here, and its sum over the histories of n steps is the total weight here.<br>权重就是历史之和的权重：以计数加权的自由分支沿每个历史复合的就是这里的权重，n 步历史之和就是这里的总重。 (`Becoming.Typicality.stepWeight`, `Becoming.Typicality.along_weight`, `Becoming.Typicality.transfer_weight`, `Becoming.Typicality.sum_courses_weight`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom and no premise: two values and natural weights p and q, written into each theorem; real weights belong to the periphery.<br>不加公理，不加前提：两个值与自然数权重 p、q 写在每条定理中；实数权重属于外围。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That the course which happens is typical: every course is a run of free branching, the all-ones course among them; reading weights as chances adds this premise.<br>发生的历程是典型的：每个历程都是自由分支的一个运行，全是一的历程亦然；把权重读作机会者加上这一前提。
- Exponential concentration (Chernoff), more than two values, and weights that are not natural numbers.<br>指数的集中（Chernoff）、多于两个值与非自然数的权重。

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. 形式模型中的规律；与实际系统的对应是另一项责任。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026; readings remain Ren's. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准；读法由 Ren 决定。

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 15 October 2026: “"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”, worlds with probability among it. Known result: Chebyshev's inequality for the binomial (Bernoulli's weak law of large numbers). Here it is given in the core with no axiom, joined to the counting weights of Becoming.Weighted, and the premise not derived is marked. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): weights are counted across courses, not registered in one; a record shows the weights exactly where the course that happens is typical, and counting says only that most are; the reading of probability lies in adding that premise.<br>Ren 2026-10-15：“"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”，其中之一是有概率的世界。已知的结果：二项分布的切比雪夫不等式（伯努利的弱大数定律）。这里在核心中不用公理地给出，接到 Becoming.Weighted 的计数权重，并标出不被推出的前提。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：权重是在历程之间计数的，不是一个历程所识的；记录显示权重，恰在发生的历程典型之处，而计数只说多数典型；概率的读法正在于加上这一前提。
